decisive_positive_prediction: Under explicit page-wide T, repeated B use during one source owner generation can retain the stock recycle condition without an extra ordinary page ref and amortize mapping work; full net gain requires saved map/unmap to exceed all implementation differences.
adjacent_failures: One B use then immediate source exit gives no repetition to amortize metadata.
A later CPU-only use is outside B authorization.
Source clears owner metadata or releases memory before actual B revoke finishes; generation check cannot undo stale hardware authority.
Concurrent target/source retirement double-unmaps, leaks mapping or accesses a dead DMA configuration.
Fan-out or deferred retirement consumes more CPU/held memory than saved.
Same-interface O3 or adapter uses the same representation and has equal complete cost.
